name: codex-pr-title-hook
description: Keep Codex task titles descriptive with colorful PR, work-time, and split badges.

interface.shortDescription: Add colorful workflow badges to descriptive task titles.
interface.longDescription: Preserve the Codex-generated task summary and prepend colorful active-time, unique PR count, and optional split badges using lifecycle hooks and the official App Server thread methods.
interface.defaultPrompt: Explain how the PR title hook works and how to verify it.
